bots.style: 依一位玩家自己的真人牌局擬合的打法。風格「鐵壁」：藍方投票比其他 AI騎士嚴。和百科AI 不同的地方：紅方第 1 局當隊長不帶隊友；忠臣和派西第 3 局起不在隊上更常放行；忠臣和派西第 3 局起在隊上很少內黑；忠臣和派西在紅方再贏一局就輸的關鍵局更不敢放行；忠臣和派西在關鍵局在隊上很少內黑；奧伯倫第 1 局上任務約 100% 直接出失敗。其他照百科AI。

knobCatalog.zh: 第 1、2 局自己是隊上唯一看得到的紅時，照強者紅方的比例偶爾出成功藏身。
knobCatalog.en: Rounds 1-2, sole visible red on the team: sometimes play success to hide, at strong human rates.

knobCatalog.zh: 第 3 局起不在隊上時，照「只看公開紀錄的忠臣」那樣投票的比例（偽裝成雜魚）。
knobCatalog.en: From round 3, off the team: share of votes cast like a public-info loyal would (camouflage).

knobCatalog.zh: 偽裝投票時，隊上沒有自己看得到的紅、忠臣會投黑的隊，改投白的比例。
knobCatalog.en: While camouflaging: chance to approve a clean-looking team that a loyal would reject.

knobCatalog.zh: 第 3 局起不在隊上、隊上沒有看得到的紅時贊成的機率。
knobCatalog.en: From round 3, off the team and no visible red on it: chance to approve.

knobCatalog.zh: 第 3、5 局紅方當隊長時，多帶一位隊友上任務的比例。
knobCatalog.en: Rounds 3 and 5 as red leader: how often to bring one extra teammate.

knobCatalog.zh: 紅方第 1 局當隊長時，前四次提議有時（約一半）放一位隊友。
knobCatalog.en: Red leader in round 1: about half of the first four proposals include a teammate.

knobCatalog.zh: 奧伯倫第 1 局上任務一律出失敗（0 = 關、1 = 開）。
knobCatalog.en: Oberon always fails a round-1 mission (0 = off, 1 = on).

knobCatalog.zh: 第 3 局起，忠臣和派西估「這隊沒有紅」的機率低於這個門檻就投黑。
knobCatalog.en: From round 3, loyals and Percival reject when the chance the team is clean is below this.

knobCatalog.zh: 紅方已拿兩局（再一個紅就輸）時，忠臣和派西的投黑門檻。
knobCatalog.en: When red has two fails already: the clean-chance bar below which loyals and Percival reject.

knobCatalog.zh: 第 3 局起忠臣和派西不在隊上時預設投黑，這隊乾淨的機率達到這個門檻才投白。
knobCatalog.en: From round 3, loyals and Percival off the team reject unless the clean chance reaches this.

knobCatalog.zh: 第 3 局起（紅方還沒拿兩局），忠臣和派西不在隊上時，估「這隊沒有紅」的機率要到這個門檻才投贊成。
knobCatalog.en: From round 3 (red below two fails), loyals and Percival off the team approve only when the chance the team is clean reaches this.

knobCatalog.zh: 第 3 局起（紅方還沒拿兩局），忠臣和派西在隊上時，估「這隊有紅、會失敗」的機率要到這個門檻才投反對（內黑）。
knobCatalog.en: From round 3 (red below two fails), loyals and Percival on the team reject only when the chance the team fails reaches this.

knobCatalog.zh: 紅方已拿兩局（再一個紅就輸）時，忠臣和派西不在隊上要多確定「這隊沒有紅」才投贊成。
knobCatalog.en: When red has two fails: how sure loyals and Percival off the team must be that the team is clean before approving.

knobCatalog.zh: 紅方已拿兩局時，忠臣和派西在隊上要多確定「這隊有紅」才投反對（內黑）。
knobCatalog.en: When red has two fails: how sure loyals and Percival on the team must be that the team fails before rejecting.

knobCatalog.zh: 梅林第 3 局起照「只看公開紀錄的忠臣」那樣投票的比例（只在會直接輸掉時才擋）。
knobCatalog.en: From round 3, share of Merlin votes cast like a public-info loyal (blocks only when a red team would win outright).

knobCatalog.zh: 第 1、2 局幾乎不會出任務的提議裡，梅林照「只看公開紀錄的忠臣」會派的隊來派的比例（看得到的紅在不在隊上照公開局勢）。
knobCatalog.en: Rounds 1-2, in proposals that will not go: share of Merlin proposals that copy what a public-info loyal would pick.

knobCatalog.zh: 派西第 1 局當隊長時，兩根拇指（梅林／莫甘娜）都不放進隊。
knobCatalog.en: Percival as leader in round 1 leaves both thumbs (Merlin / Morgana) out.

knobCatalog.zh: 刺殺用牌譜訓練的模型；關掉改用舊的經驗規則。
knobCatalog.en: Assassinate with the model trained on human games; off = the older rule of thumb.
